texts.orig: Theorem 1.1. Let ( M,F,µ ) be a forward complete n -dimensional Finsler metric measure space with finite misalignment α . Assume that the mixed weighted Ricci curvature m Ric ∞ of M is nonnegative, and that the S -curvature as well as the nonRiemannian curvatures U , T and divC = FC i jk | i dx j ⊗ dx k satisfy the norm bound F -1 | S | + F ( U )+ F ( T )+ ‖ divC ‖ HS ( V ) ≤ K 0 , for any ( x, V ) ∈ SM . Then, any bounded exponentially harmonic function u on M is constant.
